mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a quarter signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) by more than 2% in a quarter signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, which increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (below 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the federal funds rate is below 2%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and decreasing unemployment (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month, during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%), signals a supply-side shock without significant demand-side inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL < 2%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
